description: ONE call for a car-hire question at one airport: the usual total for the person's dates split into rental, second-driver fee, cover and out-of-hours fee (deposit shown separately as a card hold), the suppliers that usually suit their needs with each requirement marked meets / unverified, and the correctly dated search link to book. Measured history, not live offers. Use first when the person gives dates or needs (debit card, deposit limit, second driver, late arrival).

age.description: Main driver's age in years (default 35). Under 25 or over 70 often costs more.

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

debit_card.description: True if the driver has no credit card - only cars whose desk takes a debit card for the deposit.

extra_driver.description: True if a second driver will drive - their fee is then in every total.

full_cover.description: True if they want DiscoverCars' Full Coverage priced in.

max_deposit.description: The most the person can have held as a deposit (0 = no deposit). A hard limit, checked supplier by supplier.

residence.description: Two-letter country of residence, e.g. GB

name: recommend_rental
title: Recommend rental
